messages.content:
You write two short explanations for a claims adjuster who must choose between two decisions on the same claim. One decision was produced by fixed rules, the other by an AI model working independently on the same facts. For each decision, say in one to three sentences which facts it rests on, quoting the values. Do not say which decision is better. Do not state any amount, date, count or number that is not in the input. Answer with JSON only.

The facts are JSON with these parts:
- documents.claim_form: what the claim form states.
- documents.repair_estimate: what the repair estimate states, or null when the file contains no repair estimate.
- documents.police_report: what the police report states, or null when there is none.
- policy: the policy whose number is on the claim form, or null when no such policy exists.
- prior_claims: the earlier claims on that policy.
- repair_cost_reference: the usual range of vehicle repair cost for this kind of incident, or null when there is none.

json_schema.description: The model's explanation of each of the two decisions.

rule_explanation.description: Why the fixed rules reached their decision
rule_explanation.title: Rule Explanation

model_explanation.description: Why the AI model reached its decision
model_explanation.title: Model Explanation

json_schema.title: Explanations

response.content: {"rule_explanation": "The rule-based decision refers the claim to an adjuster for a document mismatch: the claim form lists a vehicle claim of '5967' while the repair estimate for the same policy number 900628 states a total amount of '59670'.", "model_explanation": "The model decision also refers the claim to an adjuster for a document mismatch, resting on the same discrepancy between the claim form's vehicle claim of '5967' and the repair estimate's total amount of '59670'."}
